# edit.here

> edit.here is a free image and video editor that runs entirely in the browser. Files are opened, edited and exported on the visitor's own device and are never uploaded to a server. After the first visit it also works offline.

## What it does

- Images (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP): crop, rotate and flip; draw with a pen, highlighter, arrows, boxes and text; redact with blackout, blur or pixelate; add more pictures to the canvas; frame the result with padding, rounded corners, a shadow and a background. Export as PNG, JPEG or WebP, or copy to the clipboard.
- Videos (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, M4V): trim and split, delete segments, crop, rotate and flip, change speed and volume per clip, add fades, and export.
- Recent work is kept in the browser's IndexedDB, so a reload picks up where you left off.
- Keyboard shortcuts for every tool; press ? in the app to list them.

## Privacy

Editing happens on the device. Images and videos are never uploaded, and no account is needed. The site collects only anonymous, cookieless usage counts.

## Links

- App: https://edit.here/
